title: Canonical module structure on a topological inverse image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map, $\mathcal R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y$, and $\mathcal M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. On the inverse-image sheaf of abelian groups $f^{-1}\mathcal M$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], give each section group its canonical $f^{-1}\mathcal R$-module structure: multiply local representatives on a common open before sheafification. Restrictions are semilinear. The unit $\eta_{\mathcal M}:\mathcal M\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal M$ is semilinear over $\eta_{\mathcal R}$. For an $\mathcal R$-linear morphism $a$, the underlying inverse-image abelian sheaf map $f^{-1}a$ is $f^{-1}\mathcal R$-linear.

source.place: Tag 008X, Lemma 6.24.6 (canonical inverse-image module structure); Tag 008Y (semilinear unit)

proof.text: Use lem-pc-inverse-image-presheaf-module to put a module structure on the actual Lan abelian presheaf over the actual Lan ring presheaf, with semilinear restrictions and unit. Package it with PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf.

Whisker the commutative-ring sheafification unit with forget to RingCat. Its local injectivity and surjectivity follow from the corresponding properties before forgetting. The abelian sheafification unit is also locally bijective. PresheafOfModules.Sheafify.module gives the required section module instances; Sheafify.map_smul proves restriction compatibility. The map PresheafOfModules.toSheafify is semilinear, so composing its scalar-product identity with the Lan unit identity proves semilinearity of the inverse-image unit. This proves exists_inverseImageModuleInstances.

For a module map a, compare alpha(r,m)=(inverse image a)(r*m) and beta(r,m)=r*(inverse image a)(m). Naturality of the abelian inverse-image map and the chosen restriction laws give the two restriction compatibilities. On unit images, rewrite with the chosen semilinear unit laws, adjunction unit naturality, and the original linearity of a. Apply lem-pc-inverse-image-operation-ext to conclude inverseImageMap_smul.
